To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a horizontal-aligment of nanotubes can be achieved by a proper tuning of the precursor-evaporation rate and the Ar-flow rate.

a high degree of alignment of multiwalled carbon-nanotubes in buckypapers is achieved by tuning the Cl-radical concentration and the Ar-flow rate during the CVD process, which is crucial for the fabrication of buckypapers with high Fe3C content.
the fabrication of ferro-magnetically filled buckypapers of aligned multi-walled carbon nanotube is achieved by a simple control of the flow rate of the precursor and Ar.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of buckypapers of ferromagnetics filled multi-walled carbon nanotube bundles with a high horizontal-alignment degree.
the fabrication and characterization of cm scale bucky papers of vertically and horizontally aligned multiwall carbon nanotubes (MWNTs) with a high content of Fe3C (up to 60%).
the synthesis of highly aligned ferromagnetically-filled buckypapers of multiwalled carbon-nanotubes (MWCNTs), with a high degree of alignment and a high Fe3C-content.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the flow rate of the Ar-carrier-gas is a key parameter in the fabrication of horizontally aligned multi-walled carbon nanotube buckypaper with Fe3C nanoparticles, while the evaporation-temperature of the precursor is a key parameter for a homogeneous distribution of the Fe3C nanoparticles.
the horizontal-alignment of nanotubes in the buckypaper is the key for the fabrication of a highly filled buckypaper with Fe3C.
, for a fixed dichlorebenzene concentration, the flow rates of the two gases, Ar and Cl2, play a crucial role in the formation of a highly filled and preferentially horizontally aligned buckypaper.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the higher is the evaporation temperature and the lower the Cl-flow rate, the more the nanotubes are horizontally aligned.

by decreasing the Cl-radical formation and by increasing the Ar-radical formation in the CVD reactor, the horizontal-alignment can easily be achieved, which is a key step in the fabrication of highly filled ferromagnetic buckypapers.
a higher Cl-flow rate and a lower evaporation temperature lead to a preferential horizontal-alignment of the carbon nanotubes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the flow rate of Ar and Cl-radical sources is a critical parameter for the fabrication of horizontally-aligned buckypapers.
by increasing the flow rate of the Ar-carrier-gas and decreasing the temperature of the dichlorobenzine-evaporation source, the horizontal-alignment of the nanotubes is enhanced.

a preferential horizontal-alignment is achieved for a low Cl-radical concentration, which can be achieved by lowering the dichlorobenzne concentration and the flow rates of both the Cl and the carrier gas.
